digitizer_notes: B&W negative film, single representative Sensitometric Curve (Status M Blue) + Spectral-Sensitivity (D=0.3 Above Gross Fog only, see this module's own docstring for why D=1.0 isn't captured). Both charts' tick text is OCR'd (zero real extractable tick words in either), the chart titles are also letter-spaced (each character its own text run) so locate_panel_bboxes couldn't be used -- boxes are hand-derived from real body-text word positions.
